changes: Added the Proof-or-stop thin-entrypoint contract migration execution plan and registered it in the requirements NAV. The plan defines authority layers, mechanical registries, red-to-green tests, nine follow-up Stories, rollback order, and B-e514 as the sole root-document writer.
usage: Open the plan from docs/requirements/NAV.md and implement Stories 1 through 9 in dependency order. B-e514 owns all root AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md thinning changes; other Stories must not edit those entrypoints concurrently.
expectedOutcome: The user can see the exact Proof-or-stop heading, a current-state scan manifest, target architecture, ordered Story sequence, acceptance gates, rollback procedure, and a host-neutral entrypoint policy.
actualTranscript: The live smoke command exited with code 0, printed the exact plan H1, and confirmed that docs/requirements/NAV.md contains a valid link to the plan.
outcomeDiff: The observable documentation deliverable matches the expected result. Root-entrypoint migration and runtime consumer changes remain intentionally assigned to follow-up Stories and are not claimed as implemented here.
limitations: This Story delivers the executable migration plan and navigation entry only. It does not modify AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .lattice/Lattice.md, or runtime consumers.
pitfalls: Do not thin root entrypoints before canonical documents, registries, audit consumers, and reviewer consumers are ready. B-e514 is the sole root-document writer to prevent conflicts and broken contracts.
